- Cold Rooms: Jonah (garden studio evening), Mira (harbour room morning).

Working coffee machines: harbour, print room, loading bay. Maintenance: Lift near east wing slow. Lift near loading bay slow.
- New: East wing repainting noise in afternoon. Leon prefers garden studio for reviews. Nils asked if print room is free in morning. Rafe out rest of week; Dell covering. Mira thinks library annex is too cold in afternoon.
